reason: The BEFORE code's `DOM_ENVIRONMENTS = new Set(['jsdom','happy-dom'])` is an exact-string allowlist, so custom or aliased DOM environments (e.g. a file-path or renamed happy-dom wrapper) are not recognised and vm pool candidates get pruned — exactly the bug in the linked issue that the fix addresses by inverting to a denylist, even though the reviewer's rationale confuses which side is the allowlist and its per-file-override sub-point isn't verifiable from this hunk.
